title: Faculty, Office Assistant and Attendant for RSETI Alipurduar
organization: Central Bank of India Samajik Utthan Avam Prashikshan Sansthan (CBI-SUAPS)
summary: Central Bank of India Samajik Utthan Avam Prashikshan Sansthan (CBI-SUAPS) is inviting applications for the engagement of Faculty, Office Assistant, and Attendant at RSETI Alipurduar on a contract basis for the year 2026-27. Eligible candidates must submit their applications in the prescribed format by December 15, 2026.
eligibility_bullets: Faculty: Graduate degree with preference for MSW, MA in Rural Dev, Sociology, Psychology, or Agriculture-related degrees; sound computer knowledge and local language fluency required.
Office Assistant: Graduate degree (BSW, BA, B.Com) with computer knowledge, proficiency in MS Office, and local language fluency.
Attendant: Matriculate with ability to read and write the local language.
Age limit for all posts is 22 to 40 years.
how_to_apply_steps: Download the application form from the official website notification PDF.
Fill out the application form completely and attach self-attested copies of certificates and testimonials.
Superscribe the envelope as 'Application for the post of Faculty/Office Assistant/Attendant at RSETI Alipurduar on contract for the FY year 2026-27'.

Send the application by post or deliver it to the Regional Manager/Co-Chairman, Dist. Level RSETI Advisory Committee (DLRAC), Central Bank of India, Regional Office Coochbehar, Bangchatra Road, Coochbehar, WB-736101 on or before 15.12.2026.
